variants.bio:
In the 1993 game Sonic CD for the Sega CD console, players could input a specific button combination to access a hidden "Sound Test" menu. Entering the numbers FM No. 46, PCM No. 12, and DA No. 25 triggered a bizarre, unsettling screen. It displayed a repeating background grid of Sonics with creepy humanoid smiling faces, accompanied by a tense boss track and a Japanese message reading: "Fun is infinite with Sega Enterprises. —Majin".

In this context, Majin is a reality-warping entity who rules over a vast, labyrinthine digital forest. Unlike completely malicious demons, Majin does not seek to torture or destroy out of hatred. Instead, he genuinely believes his purpose is to provide "infinite fun" to those who cross his path. However, his twisted idea of fun involves trapping mortals in his realm, brainwashing them, and mutating them into smiling clones of himself so they can stay with him forever.
